Eligibility of Tenderer :
1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 10 years.
2. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in construction works
of at least 1 contract(s) of similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully completed within the
last 5 years, each with a value of at least BDT 55 (Fifty five) crore in any Government, Semi-Government Autonomous Body of
Bangladesh over the last 5 (five) years. .
3.The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than BDT 105 crore over the last 5 years.
4. The minimum amount of Liquid Asset (free funds/cash flow) of the Tenderer shall be BDT 30 crore
5. The Contractor must have valid Trade license,Tin Certificate,VAT Certificate etc
6. Other qualification criteria are given in the Tender data sheet (TDS).
